visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a 2D animation showing a pink, mole-like man in a grey suit and red tie sitting at a light brown wooden table, looking down at a smartphone in his hands. On the table is a plate of pink, brain-like food. A small, round, brown-and-tan monkey-like character appears in the upper right background. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the monkey character's face, showing large black eyes and a small mouth. (3) Cut back to the suit-man, who now has his arms crossed and an annoyed expression with furrowed brows. (4) The scene alternates between close-ups of the monkey and the suit-man. The suit-man's face becomes progressively more distorted and red with anger, his eyes bulging and mouth wide. (5) The suit-man points a finger aggressively as the background flashes with white and grey diagonal lines. (6) A new character appears: a small, white, marshmallow-like blob with pink cheeks and a serene expression, wearing a teal top. It has its hands clasped together in a peaceful gesture. (7) Close-up of the white character looking calm and smiling gently. (8) The camera pans down to show the white character's hands using a small orange tool that emits blue electrical sparks to weld a metal handcuff around the suit-man's ankle and a wooden table leg. (9) The suit-man looks shocked and confused as a set of thick black metal bars suddenly slams down in front of him, enclosing him in a cage. (10) The monkey and the white character stand outside the cage, waving goodbye with cheerful expressions while the suit-man screams inside.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a polite, slightly nasal male voice speaking in Chinese at a moderate pace, punctuated by silence. (2) A second, deeper male voice enters with a grumpy, dismissive tone. (3) The encounter escalates into high-arousal shouting from the deeper voice, characterized by vocal strain and high intensity. (4) A sudden transition occurs to a very calm, melodic male voice singing or speaking in a lyrical, major-mode cadence accompanied by a gentle acoustic guitar. (5) This is interrupted by a sharp metallic 'click' and a sustained electrical buzzing/sparking sound (SFX). (6) A heavy metallic 'clang' occurs as if bars are closing, followed by the return of the frantic, high-pitched shouting from the first male character and a mocking, rhythmic 'Give me five' phrase from the calm character.
